requirements.statement: Package workflow state must be release_candidate (KD-3 validated).
GATE-TECHNICAL and GATE-KNOWLEDGE must be recorded with separation of duties.
SHA-256 checksum must be non-null and reproducible via the two-pass rule.
RELEASE.json must include release notes, migration notes, date, author, platform bounds, and immutability.immutable=true.
Every required dependency must already be released at a satisfying version.
Achieved quality level must be at least Bronze; target level should be declared.
Golden Dataset, snapshots, and expected outputs must not be modified to obtain a pass.
After seal_and_publish, artifact bytes must not change.
Release must not require Rule/Analysis/Interpretation/Report Engine or API modifications.
